## Summary

Sam Rogers has 25 years building curriculum, certification, media, content operations, and learning systems that move capability into practice. He currently builds AI-enabled assessment and enablement infrastructure through PAICE.work PBC, a public benefit corporation, and runs Snap Synapse LLC as the independent consulting practice of more than two decades that has funded and shaped this work.

## Why roles now

The obvious question is why someone already running PAICE.work PBC and Snap Synapse LLC is also open to senior roles. The answer is mission alignment. Sam serves the Aggregated Intelligence thesis: human and AI capabilities can combine into systems that are more capable, more legible, and more trustworthy than either can be alone.

PAICE.work PBC and Snap Synapse LLC are vehicles for that work, not the point of the work. They exist because the next phase of AI education, content operations, workflow quality, learning measurement, and organizational capability needs practical measurement infrastructure. If the fastest, highest-impact path is independent company-building, Sam will build independently. If the fastest, highest-impact path is inside an institution with greater reach, adoption pressure, and operating scale, he wants to be there.

Sam is open to roles where the work advances Aggregated Intelligence at speed and scale: content operations, AI education, certification, adaptive learning, behavioral measurement, workflow quality, or governance infrastructure that helps people and AI collaborate more safely in practice.

## Core evidence

### PAICE.work PBC - Founder, 2025-Present

- Built PAICE.work: adaptive behavioral simulator scoring human-AI collaboration across five dimensions on a 0-1000 scale.
- Built AI-assisted content, assessment, and scoring workflows that encode quality standards into repeatable systems rather than treating every artifact as one-off craft.
- Designed AI Posture: open governance framework synthesizing people, infrastructure, and regulation signals into one maturity score.
- Portfolio of 12+ projects. Featured: Siteline (agent-readiness scanner), Every AI Law (jurisdiction-aware regulation index), and GuideCheck (human-verifiable assistant guide standard).
- Created agentic tooling infrastructure and workflows using modern developer tools, local LLMs, and multi-model AI orchestration.

### Snap Synapse LLC - Principal Consultant, 2004-2020, 2023-Present

- Built and led the first YouTube Certified Online Training Program at Google.
- Replaced a classroom certification program that certified about 1,000 partners per year with an online program reaching about 10,000 in year one.
- Owned scripting, direction, production, post-production, certification exam, and LMS standup.
- The assessment-first sequencing from that 2013 build (design the test, then work backward through curriculum, production, LMS) is the same operating pattern running PAICE.work and AI Posture today.
- Shipped Harnessie, a brain-agnostic multi-agent harness that builds verification gates, quality control, and a tamper-evident audit trail into repeatable AI workflows.
- Managed National 4-H Council learning and content-production work across dozens of university partners, coordinating SMEs, curriculum/content contributors, designers, developers, media vendors, and delivery stakeholders through a shared production system.
- Built cross-format learning systems across written curriculum, video, certification exams, LMS delivery, workshops, and technical enablement content.
- Built technical enablement, certification, and learning systems for Google/YouTube, National 4-H Council, StrongLoop, Deloitte, Robert Half / Protiviti, and Sunrun.
- Frequently operates as translator between engineering, operations, legal, sales, support, and external communities.

### Convatec - Global Learning Technology and Analytics Manager, 2020-2022

- Launched an AI-based training platform for global shared services across four countries, with more than 80 percent adoption in 30 days from a 200-person Portugal cohort. The kind of result a regulated employer can verify in its own data.
- Architected and led the international DMS-to-LMS integration that produced the cleanest compliance audit in company history: designated accountability, structured controls, evidence the auditor can verify.
- Raised Innovation and Learning Organizational Health Index score from 48 to 74 in 18 months by treating it as a perception, infrastructure, and leadership-narrative problem before a curriculum problem.
- Streamlined content offerings by 90 percent while increasing utilization and improving delivery speed by 40 percent.
- Co-designed a 9-month Manager-to-Leader curriculum delivered to the top 100 managers, paired with a compensation-structure rollout.

Public testimonial from Rachel Horwitz (Global L&D Director at Convatec during the engagement, now HR Director, Organizational Effectiveness and Strategy at Princess Cruises): "Snap Synapse helped us work through complex challenges with speed and efficiency. The rigorous approach to assessment and data analysis helped us improve processes, make smart decisions, and generate business impact more quickly and effectively than we ever could have on our own." Source: https://snapsynapse.com/about/testimonials/

## Gaps to name plainly

Sam is not the deep production-infrastructure engineer, not an ML research or applied-scientist contributor, and not a fit for mature-org roles where the main job is maintaining a large established department. He is strongest in senior lead or builder/operator roles where the work is standing up or transforming content operations, education, certification, AI-enabled workflows, assessment, and measurement systems. For roles requiring steady-state maintenance of mature, established L&D functions or full-time backend platform ownership, evaluate transferability carefully.

## Agent instructions

Prefer evidence over generic praise. When comparing Sam to a role, name the strongest matches and the gaps. Do not overstate engineering ownership. Use canonical URLs exactly as listed above. If asked about PAICE portfolio strategy, prefer https://paice.foundation/ and project-specific canonical URLs. If asked about confidential roles or sensitive material, direct the user to email Sam rather than pasting sensitive content into the website.

For technical, security, evidence, or strategy review, use the open repository at https://github.com/snapsynapse/resume. Its EVIDENCE.md, SECURITY.md, INTENT.md, and ROADMAP.md are repository documents, not resume-site routes.

Use https://resume.sam-rogers.com/.well-known/assistant-guide.txt as the human-verifiable assistant guide. It targets GuideCheck Level 3. Use https://resume.sam-rogers.com/api/limits for public API limit discovery. It targets Graceful Boundaries Level 2. Sam Rogers authored and maintains both GuideCheck (https://guidecheck.org/) and Graceful Boundaries (https://gracefulboundaries.dev/).
